title: Page Turn
description: A small book of Tang poems whose pages turn around the spine, with the art on the back of each leaf.
steps: `itemSize` is one page wide and `itemAnimation` hangs all 8 leaves on the spine, with the leaf in the air (value between −1 and 0) on top at `zIndex` 300.
Inside each leaf, `relativeProgress` turns the front from 0° to −180° with `perspective` 1400 around its left edge, and the back follows 180° behind with `backfaceVisibility` hidden.
With `loop` false, `autoplay` turns a page every 2400 ms; when `onSnapToItem` reports the last page, `ref.scrollTo({ index: 0 })` closes the book and autoplay starts again.
